name: DashCore
description: DashCore 0.9.1-beta: conservative CCNode visit fast path and optional last-played-level startup loading. Diagnostic visibility analysis remains read-only; live culling stays hard-disabled.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (locked off)
experimental-render-culling.description: Not available in this beta. Live object hiding remains hard-disabled until camera-space bounds and trigger behavior are validated.

load-last-level.name: Load last played level on startup
load-last-level.description: Automatically opens the last supported standard level after the main menu loads. If it cannot be found, the main menu remains available.
